children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retrace into a range of 4,706 to 4,736 ringgit per metric ton, following its failure to break a resistance at 4,834 ringgit.
This barrier is identified as the 100% projection level of a wave c from 4,578 ringgit. It is generally considered one of this wave's endpoints.
Even if this wave eventually extends above this level, it could be disrupted by a correction toward 4,706 ringgit, as pointed by a rising trendline.

A break above 4,834 ringgit may lead to a gain into the 4,871 to 4,895 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the market faces a key resistance at 4,836 ringgit, the 61.8% retracement on the downtrend from 5,050 ringgit.
A correction toward 4,705 to 4,771 ringgit is likely to occur.
